answer: Proof-of-Personhood via social graph verification creates a digital garden where reputation is tethered to human endorsement. An attacker seeking to flood the network with fake identities faces the ember of exclusion, as they lack the deep-rooted connections required to validate accounts. Establishing a sable web of trust demands immense labor, forcing adversaries to incur prohibitive social and computational costs that make mass identity fabrication economically unsustainable.
